properties.Description: A named semantic presentation decision that is the stable interoperability contract between independently authored Meta Design Systems, Themes, and Visualizers. Its name identifies what is requested, rather than a CSS property or component implementation. A DesignToken has one DesignTokenType but never carries a Theme-specific value, CSS declaration name, alias, or rendering instruction. The term and broad semantics align with the DTCG Design Token concept, but this MAP type does not claim DTCG file-format conformance.

An abstract classification of the representation a DesignToken value may have. It is MAP's first-class representation of the DTCG Design Token Type concept, named DesignTokenType to avoid collision with MAP's general Type model. A type constrains values a Theme may assign; it does not define a semantic role, a Meta Design System, or a Theme. This family intentionally contains only classifications required by the current vertical slice and is not a full DTCG type vocabulary.

A DesignTokenType for a color value, corresponding to the DTCG color token type. It constrains a ThemeTokenAssignment to a color representation; the semantic use, such as Surface, Text, or Focus, is defined by the DesignToken instead.

A DesignTokenType for a dimension value, corresponding to the DTCG dimension token type. It constrains a ThemeTokenAssignment to a length or size representation; spacing, sizing, and other semantic roles remain distinct DesignTokens.

A DesignTokenType for a font-family value, corresponding to the DTCG fontFamily token type. It constrains a ThemeTokenAssignment to a typeface family representation without assigning that typography a semantic role.

A DesignTokenType for a font-weight value, corresponding to the DTCG fontWeight token type. It constrains a ThemeTokenAssignment to a weight representation without assigning that typography a semantic role.

A DesignTokenType for a stroke-style value, corresponding to the DTCG strokeStyle token type. It represents the styling of a stroked or bordered outline; the composite DTCG border token type is deliberately outside this initial vocabulary.
Stable machine-readable semantic name of a DesignToken. Theme projection derives its fixed CSS custom-property name from this identity.
Declares the DTCG-aligned type that constrains values assigned to a DesignToken.
